messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "sedation before and after general anesthesia"
set: ["sedation before and after general anesthesia", "sedative given after general anesthesia", "pulmonary aspiration during general anesthesia or deep sedation", "during procedures using anesthesia or sedation", "sedation", "heavy sedation", "worsened sedation", "spinal anesthesia", "planning surgery or other procedure that uses anesthesia or deep sedation", "sedation around surgery", "general ill feeling", "too much sedation", "oral dose taken 1 hour before induction of anesthesia", "receiving spinal anesthesia", "IV dose should be given immediately before induction of anesthesia", "tell healthcare team if planning surgery or other procedure that uses anesthesia or deep sedation"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
